svg.title: How to use Excel conditional formatting to color-code overdue dates and duplicate values
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to use Excel conditional formatting to color-code
overdue dates and duplicate values
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-08
Select the range to color first
It is safer to select the range containing the
actual data rather than an entire column.
Find duplicate values through the Home
tab’s rule menu
(1) Select the range. (2) On the Home tab, click
Conditional Formatting in the Styles group. (3)
Point to Highlight Cells Rules and select…
Mark overdue rows with a formula rule
When you need to check two or more columns
together, such as for a deadline condition,
create a new rule in Conditional Formatting and…
Check the order when there are
multiple rules
When multiple rules apply to the same cell, open
the list through Home → Conditional Formatting →
Manage Rules.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
